name: Demo: Terminal Impulse Creation
description: Demonstrates MiniBob creating impulses from terminal vessel interactions

config.command: TERMINAL_ID=$(echo '{{impulses.stdout.content}}' | jq -r '.terminalId') && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:9137/v2/terminals/send -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"terminalId":"'$TERMINAL_ID'","input":"echo Hello from MiniBob!\n"}'

TERMINAL_ID=$(echo '{{impulses.stdout.content}}' | jq -r '.terminalId') && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:9137/v2/impulses/resolve -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"pointer":{"type":"terminalState","terminalId":"'$TERMINAL_ID'"}}'

tasks.description: Create observation memo about the impulse

prompt.template:
Analyze this terminal state impulse and describe what MiniBob observed:

{{impulses.terminalState.content}}

Provide:
1. What command was executed
2. What output was captured
3. How this demonstrates impulse creation from terminal vessel

Be concise but specific.
